hero.headline: Design That Thinks.
hero.subheadline: I'm Prince Kofi Sarfo — a Biomedical Engineer turned Creative Director, building brands that don't just look good. They think. They convert. They evolve.

services.title: Brand Identity
services.description: From your brand's first logo to a full campaign — precision meets purpose. I build identities that work across every touchpoint.
services.body: From naming and positioning to visual identity systems, I create brands built to last. Each identity is grounded in strategy and crafted with precision.

services.title: Print & Packaging
services.description: Labels, packaging, merchandise, and print collateral designed with the care of a surgeon and the eye of an artist.
services.body: From pharmaceutical labels to luxury packaging, I design print work that communicates quality at a glance. Every millimetre is deliberate.

services.title: Social Media Design
services.description: Content that stops the scroll. Campaign visuals, ads, and digital assets built for engagement and brand consistency.
services.body: I design social content that builds brand equity with every post — cohesive, purposeful, and impossible to ignore.

services.title: Motion & Video
services.description: Brand motion that brings your identity alive — animated logos, explainer content, and visual storytelling.
services.body: From animated brand marks to full explainer videos, I add dimension to your identity through motion that feels intentional.

services.title: Web & Digital Design
services.description: Clean, purposeful digital experiences. UI design and web visuals that convert visitors into clients.
services.body: I design digital experiences that reflect your brand's full potential — structured, conversion-focused, and visually compelling.

services.title: Brand Strategy
services.description: Repositioning. Refreshing. Rebuilding. Strategic guidance for brands ready to evolve with intention.
services.body: Whether you're launching or repositioning, I help you define what you stand for and build the visual language to say it.

about.headline: The mind behind psycheevo.
about.body: I'm Prince Kofi Sarfo — a Biomedical Engineer turned Creative Director. Where analytical rigour meets bold creative vision lives psycheevo. — where analytical precision meets bold creative instinct. I don't just design for aesthetics. I design for outcomes.
about.quote: Design without strategy is decoration. Strategy without design is invisible.
about.name: Prince Kofi Sarfo
